title: MA41006: Complex Analysis
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: void
Review of functions of complex variables including complex integrals. Mapping
by elementary functions and transformations. Residue and poles and its
applications to solve improper/proper integrals. Conformal mapping and its
applications. Entire and meromorphic functions, growth of entire functions.
Univalent functions and their geometric aspects.
